{{Top|leg}}
The '''KL-44 Commander shield projector''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] system produced by [[Sirplex/Legends|Sirplex]] during the [[Galactic War]]. The KL-44 had a low baseline shield strength and a fast regeneration rate, but could project shields over nearby allied ships for a short duration in order to boost their shields along with the ship's own.
